thread:
Alex H: Quick sync — onboarding a new org (AcmeCorp). Need a cross-cloud checklist for account/project setup + GPU quota bump requests across AWS/GCP/Azure. TL;DR: we want minimal blast radius, billing set, tags, IAM, and quota requests submitted.

Jamie P: +1. Suggested sections: accounts & projects, IAM/service accounts, networking (VPC/subnets/reserved IPs), billing/export, tagging & naming, quota requests, region fallback plan, validation & smoke tests.

Maria G: Kicking off with an example quota request template we can reuse. Use this text for support forms:```
Customer: AcmeCorp
Environment: production (reserved capacity)
Region(s): us-west-2, us-central1, westeurope
Resource: NVIDIA A100 (p4, a3) GPUs
Current quota: 0
Target quota: 40 GPUs (20 us-west-2, 12 us-central1, 8 westeurope)
Requested timeline: 2–3 weeks
Business justification: Reserved inference capacity for customer SLA-backed deployment; will use dedicated pools and autoscaling; committed spend planned.
Contact: ops@redwood.example.com
```
Use the same pattern for Azure but list VM SKUs (NDv4, NCasT4) and regions.

Lee C: I'll start the AWS Service Quotas requests for us-west-2 and eu-west-1 today. For GCP I'll open quota case for GPUs + local SSDs in us-central1. Who owns the billing export for this org?

Alex H: @Maria G owns billing export setup. Maria, please enable BigQuery billing export & AWS Cost and Usage Report (daily) and add AcmeCorp billing account to our enterprise payer with tags.

Maria G: On it. Checklist item: create org node -> create project per env (prod/stage/dev) -> enable billing -> enable org policy for allowed service-perimeters -> enable VPC SC if needed. Also enable audit logs (admin, data_access) for each project.

Jamie P: IAM notes: follow least privilege. Seed these groups: infra-admins, infra-ops, infra-readonly. Create a dedicated service account for inference deployment with roles: compute.admin (limited to project), iam.serviceAccountUser, monitoring.metricWriter, storage.objectViewer. Avoid broad roles at org level.

sre-oncall: Networking gotcha — if you plan cross-region failover, reserve static ips (GCP: static regional external IPs, AWS: Elastic IPs attached to NAT/ENIs) and check cloud-provider limits for ephemeral IPs. Also bump subnet IP counts early if we allocate large clusters.

Jamie P: Tagging naming convention to apply on all resources: `team:redwood`, `owner:acme-infra`, `env:prod|stage|dev`, `cost-center:ACME-<team>`. Put these in org policy to enforce.

Lee C: Small CLI snippets: AWS Service Quotas request example:
```
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A --desired-value 40 --region us-west-2
```
GCP quota request via gcloud (create case):
```
gcloud alpha services quota-tiers cases create --project=acme-prod --description="GPU quota increase" --resources="compute.googleapis.com" --region=us-central1
```
(also file web support ticket with JSON from Maria)

quota-bot: Created ticket Q-4321 for AWS quota increases (us-west-2, eu-west-1) assigned to Lee C — ETA 3 business days.

Alex H: Cost consideration — ask for separate quota pools per customer in Dedicated. If cloud provider won't isolate, plan warm-up windows and tagging to measure actual steady-state. Forecast expected monthly GPU hours and attach to quota ticket.

Maria G: Validation tests after quotas approved: 1) spin-up single node with requested GPU SKU, 2) run micro-benchmark (latency + throughput), 3) register node in our fleet, 4) end-to-end app smoke calling model. Add these to automation pipeline.

Lee C: I'll track tasks in the provisioning runbook and post a summary when all quota increases are confirmed. Will ping once tickets are live.

Alex H: Thanks team. If anyone sees region capacity warnings (provider console) DM me. Also add fallback regions in the checklist (e.g., if A100 unavailable in us-west-2, fallback to us-west-1 or eu-west-1) and include expected perf delta. :thumbsup:
